budget.rationale: Throughput probe, not a results campaign. Twenty-five iterations on one cell give timing at five points, so per-iteration cost and any growth across the run can be read off rather than extrapolated from a single number. The barren-search guard aborts a non-functioning environment after five iterations, so a broken run costs a minute rather than a wall-clock. No model from this root may be evaluated or reported.

prompt_policy.description: Declared adaptation. The upstream protocol withholds variable meanings and system descriptions to mitigate memorisation; this benchmark controls for that with its named/obfuscated pairing, so the specification is supplied to equalise information with the other LLM baselines. Search instructions, operators, fitting and selection are unchanged.
